Medium yellow Floribunda.
Registration name: JACsile
Exhibition name: Mirabella ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, before 1995).
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 1998 as 'Mirabella'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Strong fragrance. 41 petals. Large, very full (41+ petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.

rows.Notes: A user emails: Mirabella (a/k/a JACjubel) is a fabulously vigorous Floribunda, medium yellow, fragrant rose that used to be sold by Jackson & Perkins but is no longer in their catalog. After some research, the most closely related rose that I have been able to find available at retail is 'Sunsprite'.
